supersedes: legacy results/trajectory_tda_integration/06_stratified.json (B=100, pre-frozen-loadings, mean-vs-individual W2 construction, pairwise-between-subgroup) -- preserved, not citable
scope_reason: P01-A response plan ISSUE B8: 50 stratification tests (2 gender + 6 NS-SEC + 42 cohort) were pooled into one BH family. v2 requires (1) recompute under the locked pipeline (frozen loadings, B>=1000, mean-vs-mean T_ratio + BCa CI per B2.6) because the legacy data uses the retired construction, then (2) three separate FDR families by axis with BY for the positively-correlated cohort family. The per-subgroup test model is fixed by B8's count (50 = 2+6+42 -> one test per subgroup), NOT the legacy pairwise-between-subgroup construction. USoc AND BHPS (User-approved 2026-06-13).

entries.name: Section 6.1 per-subgroup stratified W2 recompute + per-family FDR
entries.objective: Recompute each demographic subgroup's Markov-1 W2 test under the locked pipeline for USoc and BHPS, then apply per-family FDR (BH gender, BH NS-SEC, BY cohort) with effect sizes.

test_model.per_subgroup_test: For each subgroup g (e.g. gender=Female), take the subgroup's trajectories, embed under the FROZEN full-sample scaler/PCA-20 loadings (transform-only), compute persistence, and run the canonical Markov-1 W2 headline (subgroup observed PD vs its own Markov-1 null). One test per subgroup -- NOT pairwise-between-subgroup. 50 tests per dataset: gender (2: Female, Male), NS-SEC (6 classes), cohort (42 bins).
test_model.statistic: mean-vs-mean T_ratio = mean(W_obs-null) / mean(W_null-null), with 95% BCa CI (delta-method fallback if only summaries are stored), per B2 / B2.6.
test_model.complement: landscape L2 reported alongside W2 per the mandatory dual-metric rule.
test_model.strata_to_confirm_at_assembly: NS-SEC = the 6-class variable used in v1 section 6.1 (legacy key 'parental_nssec'); cohort = the 42-bin definition from v1 section 6.1 / legacy '06_stratified.json'. Confirm both against the legacy keys (gender/parental_nssec/cohort/gor) when assembling subgroup membership; region/gor is NOT a B8 family and is excluded.

cohort.reference: Benjamini & Yekutieli (2001), positively-correlated adjacent cohort tests

key_params.landmark_note: actual_landmarks = min(L, subgroup_n); small subgroups run at <100% to 100% landmark fraction -- report actual_landmarks per subgroup (per the T1.26/T1.26b landmark-fraction lesson, the varying fraction is a disclosed feature of stratified tests, not a defect).
key_params.effect_sizes: T_ratio + 95% BCa CI reported beside every raw and FDR-adjusted p

reporting_protocol.rule: Report each subgroup's raw p, FDR-adjusted p (by family/axis), and effect size; flag significance per family. This is a recompute + multiple-comparison correction, not an A/B/C prose-direction lock.
reporting_protocol.contingency: If a subgroup heterogeneity claim asserted in v1 section 6.1 (e.g. a gender persistence difference) CHANGES significance status after recompute + FDR, surface it to the User before section 6.1 v2 prose is drafted (do not silently overturn a v1 claim).

entries.execution_guardrails: ~50 subgroup runs x 2 datasets = ~100 mini-headline Markov-1 W2 runs at B>=1000, each with its own subgroup Markov-1 null bank. Heavy. Benchmark per-subgroup cost first; >=4-worker single reusable executor; checkpoint PER SUBGROUP; resumable; up-front wall-time estimate; pause for Manager direction if the projection exceeds 12h at 4 workers. Preserve legacy 06_stratified.json (no overwrite).

planned_contracts.required_keys: schema_version (str); generated_at (str); task ('T1.28 ...'); pre_registration (refs 2026-06-13); inputs (git_head + frozen-loadings provenance); params (null_model=='markov-1', frozen_loadings==true, B>=1000, seed==42, p_value_formula=='(r+1)/(B+1)'); datasets (dict with keys 'usoc' and 'bhps'); each dataset has subgroups[] where every item carries stratifier in {gender,nssec,cohort}, subgroup_id (str), n (int>0), actual_landmarks (int>0, <= min(5000,n)), t_ratio (float), bca_ci ([lo,hi] floats, lo<=hi), w2_p (float in [0,1]), w2_rejects (bool == w2_p<0.05), landscape_l2_p (float in [0,1]); per dataset family counts gender==2, nssec==6, cohort==42 (50 total)
